name: zdi_set_entry_value_for_all_entries
description: zDi::SetEntryValueForAllEntries writes one shared draw/entry value to every DI entry.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this small DI entry helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel/zDi source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x484140 validates null self return, entry-count early return, 0x1c-byte zDiEntry stride, and writing the shared EDX value to each entry offset 0x04.
The native smoke verifies all entries receive the shared draw value, null self is accepted, and a zero-entry DI leaves the entry array unchanged.
